scope: Frozen plain Llama-70B, frozen Centaur-70B, original/US/China label prompts, and a Giving allocation histogram. No existing culture-adapter probabilities included.
limitations: Validation status is explicit caller input; inspect independent source-column audit evidence before interpreting allocation outcomes.
Giving participants are held out relative to saved culture-training manifests, not necessarily upstream Centaur pretraining.
